question: Who was awarded Sahitya Akademi award for English in 2020 for the novel 'Requiem in Raga Janki'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neelum Saran Gour**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neelum Saran Gour** is the distinguished author honored with the **Sahitya Akademi Award** in the **English** language category for her novel **'Requiem in Raga Janki'**.
 
• The novel is a fictionalized biography of **Janki Bai**, also known as **Chhappan Chhuri**, a legendary **Hindustani classical musician** and an early recording star from **Allahabad**.
 
• The narrative provides a rich **socio-cultural history** of early 20th-century India, capturing the evolution of the **music industry** from the era of royal patronage to the advent of the **gramophone**.
 
• The work is highly praised for its lyrical prose and meticulous **historical research**, blending the personal tragedy of the protagonist with the broader musical heritage of North India.
 
• The **Sahitya Akademi Award**, established in **1954**, is one of the most prestigious literary recognitions in India, awarded by the **National Academy of Letters** to outstanding books in **24 major Indian languages**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arundhathi Subramaniam**:

 
 
• She was the recipient of the **Sahitya Akademi Award 2020** for her poetry collection **'When God is a Traveller'**.
 
• Her work is noted for its **metaphysical inquiry** and exploration of spiritual journeys and contemporary identity.
 
 
 
• **Namita Gokhale**:
 
 
• Awarded the **Sahitya Akademi Award 2021** for her historical novel **'Things to Leave Behind'**.
 
• She is a prominent literary figure and a **founder-director** of the world-renowned **Jaipur Literature Festival**.
 
 
 
• **Anuradha Roy**:
 
 
• A celebrated Indian novelist who won the **Sahitya Akademi Award 2022** for **'All the Lives We Never Lived'**.
 
• She was also longlisted for the **Man Booker Prize** and won the **DSC Prize for South Asian Literature** for her novel **'Sleeping on Jupiter'**.
